name: wall press heel tap
description: A supine core drill with the hands pressing into a wall behind the head while the heels alternately tap the floor.
instructions: Lie on your back with your head close to a wall and press both hands into the wall above and behind you.
Lift your legs into a tabletop position and gently press your lower back toward the floor.
Lower one heel to tap the floor while keeping the other knee lifted.
Return to tabletop and alternate sides without arching your back.
